pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding positions (averaging down or scaling into falling momentum) within 3 minutes of a prior stop-loss event.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order-flow imbalance filter: entry requires localized volume delta confirmation and a tight ATR-bounded volatility cap of max 4.5 dollars.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing take-profit steps starting at +$12.00 unrealized profit to guarantee a minimum +$15.00 to +$30.00 capture on directional expansions.
